propositions: transport parameters in reconciler core modules are unannotated or annotated as Any, defeating mypy's ability to enforce port completeness and enabling undeclared-member defects like a357

port type annotations imported via the unresolvable rebar_reconciler.* path are silently widened to Any by mypy's ignore_missing_imports setting, so annotations enforce nothing unless imported by a resolvable path (e.g. relative imports from ._backend)

the _TransportPortMeta metaclass does not prevent attribute checking; its presence was a confounded measurement; mypy enforces [attr-defined] errors against TicketTransport when imported resolvably regardless of metaclass

capability members (add_comment, set_relationship, get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map) carried as metaclass attributes are not visible to mypy protocol checking, creating gaps the AST audit cannot detect but mypy can, requiring narrowed capability-specific Protocol views at call sites

the strictness ratchet disallow_untyped_defs does not prevent this defect because annotating as Any satisfies the ratchet while remaining blind at port boundaries, so annotation quality enforcement must check both annotation presence and import path resolvability
